### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A01 was not observed in any of the 200 traces; in the later window it occurs exactly once in every trace (participation and mean occurrences per trace both 100 in 100). [OCC001]
- In the later window, A01 always sits at the final position of its trace (mean and median position 1.0, no spread); in the earlier window it had no observed position at all. [POS001]
- A06 occurs in every trace in both windows. Earlier it was always the last activity (position 1.0 in 200 of 200 traces, no variation); in the later window it sits slightly before the end (median about 0.88 of the trace, with small variation). [POS002]
- In the earlier window no outgoing transition from A06 was observed, consistent with A06 ending the trace; in the later window all of A06's observed outgoing flow goes to A01. [DIR001]
- The A01–A06 relation changed from "A06 without A01" in 200 of 200 earlier traces to "both activities together, A06 before A01" in 200 of 200 later traces. [REL001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

A possibility directly supported by the evidence is that A01 was introduced as a new concluding activity, executed exactly once after A06: traces that previously ended with A06 now end with A06 followed by A01. The supporting signs are consistent and direct: A01's participation rose from not observed to 100 in 100 traces; the relational evidence shows A01 and A06 co-occurring with A06 first in every later trace; A06's outgoing flow, previously unobserved, now goes entirely to A01; and A06's shift away from the final position matches an insertion after it. The five qualifying control-flow items far exceed the roughly 0.04 items expected by chance across the 8 tested units, so the set of differences is unlikely for an unchanged process. [OCC001, POS001, POS002, DIR001, REL001]

Limitations: zero participation in the earlier window means only that A01 was not observed there, so a previously very rare A01 that became mandatory cannot be distinguished from a newly added activity. The evidence covers only A01 and A06, so any further changes elsewhere in the process would not be visible. [OCC001, REL001]
